snippet.title: Apothecary of City X | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Proudly revealing Apothecary of City X, a strategy simulation game where players make ends meet running a warm,cosy apothecary in an otherwise dark and dystopian future city. Lead developer Anna Zou (Hand of Fate, Hand of Fate 2) has poured her feelings about climate change into this atmospheric cybercore title along with the rest of the team at Lemon Jolly – look out for an early access release in November 2025!
